translation.name: Ri C'ac'a Trato ri Xuben ri Dios Quiq'uin ri Vinek

book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: Ri carta ri xutz'ibaj ri apóstol San Pablo chique ri kach'alal ri ec'o pa Roma

content: Ri rubanic ri c'aslen ri nika' chuvech ri Dios

Vach'alal, ri Dios can nujoyovaj c'a kavech janíla. Romari' ninc'utuj utzil chive chi tic'utu' c'a ri matioxinic c'o iviq'uin; tijacha-ivi' pa ruk'a' ri Dios. Can achi'el xban chique ri chicop ri xesuj chire ri Dios, que chuka' ri' tibana' rix, tiya' ri ic'aslen chire ri Dios. Jun lok'olej c'aslen, jun c'aslen ri nika' chuvech ri Dios, jari' tiya' chire, y queri' rix can kitzij niya' ruk'ij ri Dios.

Man titzekelbej ri quic'aslen ri vinek ri c'a quicukuban na quic'u'x riq'uin re ruvach'ulef. Xa can tiya' k'ij chire ri Dios richin nujel ri ich'obonic, richin queri' can tijalatej c'a chuka' rubanic ri ic'aslen. Y queri' xtivetamaj ri achique nrajo' ri Dios chi nikaben. Ri nrajo' rija', ja ri utz, ri jebel y ri tz'akatinek.

Ri Dios xuya' rutzil chuve y xiruya' chupan ri rusamaj. Romari' ninbij chive chi'ivonojel: Man tinimirisaj-ivi', roma man ruc'amon ta chi queri' niben. Nic'atzin chi nitz'et-ka-ivi', vi can kitzij icukuban ic'u'x riq'uin ri Dios y vi yixajin chubanic ri samaj ri yo'on chive roma ri Dios. Roma konojel jalajoj ruvech kasamaj ruyo'on.
Can achi'el rubanon ri kach'acul, c'o ruk'a', c'o raken, c'o runak'-ruvech, pero man junan ta quisamaj.
Y que chuka' ri' roj ri kaniman ri Cristo, oj q'uiy y man junan ta ri kasamaj. Pero junan kavech y nikatola-ki' roma jun kabanon riq'uin ri Cristo.

Can kac'ulun c'a rutzil ri Dios, roma can rubanon chike chikajujunal, chi c'o jun kasamaj ruyo'on. Romari', vi c'o ri nuk'alajirisaj ri Dios chike, can tikak'alajirisaj c'a chique ri ch'aka' chic. Y tikak'alajirisaj c'a ri kac'ulun.
Vi yojtiquir yekato' ri ch'aka' chic, quekato'. Vi yojtiquir yojtijon, kojtijon.

Vi yojtiquir nikacukuba' quic'u'x ri ch'aka' chic, tikabana'. Vi yojtiquir yekato' riq'uin ri ka-mero, quekato' riq'uin ronojel kánima. Vi ja roj ri yojuc'uan quichin, can tikatija' kak'ij chi utz quic'uaxic nikaben. Vi can yojtiquir c'a yekato', can quekato' c'a riq'uin quicoten.
Ri nrajo' ri Dios richin niquiben ri e ralc'ual chic
Can quixajovan c'a riq'uin ronojel ivánima. Tivetzelaj ri man utz ta y tivojkaj ri utz.
Ivach'alal ivi' roma iniman ri Cristo. Roma c'a ri' can tivajovala-ivi' riq'uin ronojel ivánima y tinimala-ivi'.
Man quixk'oran, xa riq'uin ronojel ivánima tibana' ri rusamaj ri Ajaf.
Tiquicot ri ivánima roma ivoyoben ri utzil ri xtuya' ri Dios. Ticoch'o' ri tijoj-pokonal ri nic'ovisaj. Benek-ruvech tibana' orar.
Tok ec'o ch'aka' lok'olej tak kach'alal c'o ri nic'atzin chique, que'ito'. Tisuju' qui-posada tok nic'atzin.
Ri vinek ri ye'etzelan ivichin y niquiben chive chi nitej pokon, tic'utuj ri rutzil ri Dios pa quivi', y man tic'utuj chi nika' ruc'ayeval pa quivi' roma ri itzel tak quibanobal.
Quixquicot quiq'uin ri yequicot, y quixok' quiq'uin ri ye'ok' roma bis.
Junan ivech tibana'. Man tinimirisaj-ivi'. Xa tich'utinirisaj-ivi' y man tich'ob chi janíla etamabel c'o iviq'uin.
Vi c'o c'a jun vinek ri c'o itzel nuben chive, man tiben ruq'uexel chire. Jantape' tic'uaj jun c'aslen utz, richin chi man jun nilitej chivij.
Man c'a tiben oyoval, xa titija' ik'ij chi jebel nic'uaj-ivi' quiq'uin conojel.

Rix ri yalan yixinvajo', ninbij c'a chive: Vi ec'o ri yebanon itzel chive, man tiben ruq'uexel chique. Xa tiya' pa ruk'a' ri Dios, roma ja rija' ri xtiyo'on rutojbalil ri itzel tak quibanobal. Can achi'el ri nubij ri Dios chupan ri tz'ibatel can: Pa nuk'a' yin c'o-vi ri ruc'ayeval y ninya' rutojbalil chique ri yemacun. Queri' nubij ri Ajaf.

Y romari' ri ruch'abel ri Dios ri tz'ibatel can, nubij: Vi ninum ri netzelan avichin, rat can taya' c'a ruvay. Y vi nichaki'j ruchi', taya' ruya'. Vi queri' xtaben, rija' xa xtiq'uixbitej roma ri itzel tak rubanobal rubanon. Queri' nubij ri tz'ibatel can.
Man tiya' k'ij chi yixch'acatej roma ri itzel ri niban chive. Rix ja ri utz ri tibana' y jare' ri xtich'acon chirij ri itzel.
